basic_info.description: PANO VIEW - Amazing opportunity to turn this Mid-Century View Gem into a special retreat! Experience breathtaking panoramic views where the beauty of San Francisco unfolds right from your kitchen, living and dining rooms. Step onto the walkout deck and take in the sweeping vistas that make this home truly special. Located on a quiet, private cul-de-sac in Miraloma Park, on the border of Sherwood Forest, this location combines tranquility with central convenience. Just one block from the Mt. Davidson open space and trails, and close to the 36 MUNI line, you'll have nature and easy transit at your doorstep. Enjoy proximity to top schools, West Portal, Miraloma Park, and Glen Park for dining, shopping, and community life. Hardwood floors throughout and a seamless layout w/2 spacious bedrooms, 2 baths w/option to add 3rd bedroom on the main level. The open living/dining area, complete with a fireplace and panoramic views, is perfect for hosting or relaxing. The lower level adds flexibility, featuring a family room or guest quarters, a wet bar, a half bath, and an ideal home office space. With a two-car side-by-side garage, this home offers both functionality and potential to make this the perfect spot to enjoy San Francisco living at its best!
